name: Second Tenant

brand.tagline: A maintained service run as an autonomous system on Ultrastable, the foundation for any autonomous system.

idea: A small service that must keep running: it deploys itself on its own loop, probes its own health and files its own repairs, with no dependence on tenant 0's loops.
goals: Deploy unattended on its own loop
Probe its own health every cycle and file breaches
Stay within a stated monthly budget
positioning: Second Tenant is the proof that the product runs beyond tenant 0: same kernel, its own manifest, its own deploy loop.

system_test.loop: its own cron deploys and probes its health, and a failed probe files its own repair, with no person in the middle
system_test.upkeep: runtime, dependency and model changes keep arriving every month
system_test.run_cost: 5 USD a month for the back end
